title: RH - Hot-Mix Asphalt, Tack and Prime - AVON PARK
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR MOBILITY COMMAND.FA4814 6 CONS PK
description_text: The Contractor shall provide all plant, labor, material, design and supervision to provide and deliver approximately 8,001 tons of hot mix asphalt (HMA), and 8,072 gallons of Bituminous Tack and Prime Coats. Contractor shall also provide field and laboratory quality control testing, as required by the Government. Please see attached SOW for more information. RFI Questions must be submitted no later than 21 April 2026 Note: All responses to this notice will only be shared with the Government project management team and will be held in strict confidence. POC: SrA Jon Soucy Email: jonsoucy@us.af.mil
